theorem sum_abs_coefI2_mul_le {U V M : ℝ} (hU : 1 ≤ U) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (hM : 0 ≤ M) {q : ℕ}
    (hq : Odd q) :
    ∑ a ∈ Icc 1 ⌊M⌋₊, (if Odd a ∧ q ∣ a then |coefI2 U V a| * a else 0) ≤
      M ^ 2 * Real.log V / (4 * q) + 3 * c₄ / 4 * M * V +
        3 / 2 * (U + 1) ^ 2 * V * Real.log q / 4 :=

note: Not formalized and not needed: the one place [H] invokes (2.16), (4.55), only needs ψ(V) ≤ 1.03884V, which (2.15) gives. Erratum: For y > 200000 the book derives (2.16), sum_{n<=y} Lambda(n)n < 1.03884 y^2/2, from (2.15) psi(y) < 1.03883y and partial summation; that route gives at best about 1.0776 y^2/2 (2*1.03883 - 1 in the limit) even with int psi known exactly, and an upper bound on psi cannot control -int psi at all. (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_2_16.py`).
